description_en: Query all works under the entire organization, with the option to specify the type of work
description_zh: 查询整个组织下的所有作品，可指定作品类型
name: QueryWorksByOrganization

parameters.description_en:
The type of work to query. Leave blank to query all types. Possible values:

- DATAPRODUCT: Data Portal
- PAGE: Dashboard
- REPORT: Spreadsheet
- dashboardOfflineQuery: Self-service Data Retrieval
parameters.description_zh:
查询作品的类型，填空为查询所有类型。取值范围：

- DATAPRODUCT：数据门户
- PAGE：仪表板
- REPORT：电子表格
- dashboardOfflineQuery：自助取数

parameters.description_en:
The status of the work to query. Possible values:

- 0: Unpublished
- 1: Published
- 2: Modified but not published
- 3: Offline

- 0：未发布
- 1：已发布
- 2：已修改未发布
- 3：已下线
